Boston Scientific credit rating 2026 Moody's S&P

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：客戶包含經銷商、醫院、醫療機構等多元對象，付款條件美國通常30天、國際可能更長，一般不要求擔保品；金融工具交易對手為投資級大型金融機構。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 8 Concentrations of Credit Risk
findings.excerpt: In the normal course, our payment terms with customers, including distributors, hospitals, health care agencies, clinics, doctors' offices and other private and governmental institutions, are typically 30 days in the U.S. but may be longer in international markets and generally do not require collateral.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 搜尋未找到2026年信評或客戶破產/降評事件；FY2024 10-K 搜尋摘要稱無單一客戶超過淨銷售10%，未取得逐字原文。

clues.claim: FY2024 10-K：2024/2023/2022 無單一客戶占淨銷售逾10%；GPO、醫院網絡、國際經銷商為重要買方群。
